review:
Royal Beellion Hold & Win is a luxurious 60-line classic set in a golden beehive. Three or more scatters pay anywhere, and six or more bee symbols trigger the Hold & Win bonus.

Inside the bonus there are four prizes and pre-bonus multipliers placed on cells; if a progressive mystery symbol lands in a cell with a multiplier, that multiplier applies to its final value at the end of the round. Expanding wilds help in the base game. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. A polished take on the land-based hold-and-win style.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published

Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
